answer: ZK proof-of-post-epoch at the quartz: each miner submits a succinct proof that its epoch work was generated locally, verified in ~5ms. The falcon signature binds proof to one device key, so a farm must rent unique hardware: 500 CPU-hours per identity, ~$12 each. The reef absorbs honest miners while sybils drown at 10k+ identities. Works because forging proofs costs more than mining rewards.
